art.title: The Quarry of Monsieur Pascal near Nanterre
art.why: Men cutting stone at every level of a quarry: Job 28's picture of people digging the earth for treasure, while wisdom can't be dug out.
Blake's Job engravings are not in NGA's open-access painting data.

art.title: Job and His Daughters
art.why: REUSE of an existing art id, exactly right: Job 42:13–15, Job restored, with his three daughters around him. Already used by a daily story in bank.json, not by any journey.

music.why: 'I know that my Redeemer liveth' opens Part III of Handel's Messiah: Job 19:25 heard as Christian hope.
